generation_fact: A generation_fact is one atomic relation binding source information, the realized transformation, one concrete occurrence, the formed outcome, and its relation role.
generation_occurrence: A generation_occurrence identifies one concrete execution; it can establish several distinct generation facts.
atomic_generation_fact: Each generation fact preserves its exact source, transformation, occurrence, outcome, and role as one indivisible relation.
realizes_fact: realizes_fact connects an occurrence node to each particular fact that the occurrence established.
reads_from: reads_from records an actual data dependency and must not be inferred merely from execution order, time, or value equality.
GeneratedOrigin: GeneratedOrigin records that an outcome formed earlier participates as a source in a later generation fact.
program_order: program_order records declared execution order but does not by itself establish a data dependency or concurrency fact.
equal_values: Equal numeric values or equal outputs do not identify the same fact, occurrence, result, or formation.
cartesian_recombination: Facts from one occurrence must not be split into source and result sets and falsely recombined by Cartesian product.
missing_relations: A missing relation means it was not established; it does not automatically prove the relation false, and absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: A forward training query follows exact identities along training sample to batch occurrence to forward occurrence to loss to backward occurrence to gradient to optimizer occurrence to new parameter version.
reverse_query: A reverse query starts from an evaluation or parameter result and follows actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations; timestamp proximity and numeric similarity are not substitutes.
